{{Quote|Good. Get back to the ship, load your gear into the speeder truck, and get over here. I’ll meet you at the Iceview Tapcaf across from the palace in two hours.|Mara Jade to [[Daric LaRone]]|<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
'''Iceview Tapcaf''' was located in [[Whitestone City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]]. [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] ordered the [[Hand of Judgment]], a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] squad that deserted the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], to meet her there.<ref name="COO" />
